title: Cinderella Pumpkin Bowl with Vegetables and Sausage
description: Use a hollowed-out pumpkin to cook and serve a bonanza of vegetables, from carrots and broccoli to rutabaga and cabbage seasoned with onion soup mix and kielbasa sausage.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package kielbasa sausage, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces
3 cloves garlic - minced, or amount to taste
2 cups cooked white or brown rice
0.5 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
0.5 (1.25 ounce) envelope dry onion soup mix
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Cut around the top of pumpkin to make a lid. Use a large metal spoon to scoop out inside membrane and seeds. Place hollowed-out pumpkin with lid on the prepared baking sheet,
Cook in the preheated oven for 1 hour, then lower heat to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

Meanwhile, place sausage in a deep pot over medium-high heat. Cook until evenly browned, turning frequently, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in carrots, celery, onion, and garlic; cook and stir until translucent and tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in parsnips, rutabaga, and cabbage; cook until vegetables are almost tender, about 5 minutes. Add bell peppers, broccoli, zucchini, and corn. Pour in chicken broth, add rice, and cook for 5 minutes more. Stir in parsley, red pepper flakes, onion soup mix, and Italian seasoning until incorporated; season with salt and pepper.
Keeping pumpkin on the baking sheet, spoon vegetable-sausage mixture into pumpkin, and replace the lid. Loosely cover pumpkin with aluminum foil.

Continue cooking pumpkin in the preheated oven until flesh is tender, about 4 hours. Scoop some of the pumpkin flesh away from the sides to combine with vegetable mixture. To serve, place pumpkin on a serving platter and remove the lid to ladle out the contents.
